display.name: Xcode Builds
display.description: Experimental Apple build observation. Timestamped host samples accompany build outcomes and aggregate task work.

display.name: Recent Xcode builds
display.description: Build duration includes the wrapped xcodebuild process. Open a trace from Live using its trace ID.

spec.query:
SELECT start_timestamp AS started, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario,
 attributes->>'build.scheme' AS scheme, attributes->>'build.destination' AS destination,
 attributes->>'build.cache_state' AS cache, (attributes->>'build.exit_code')::bigint AS exit_code,
 (attributes->>'build.duration_seconds')::double AS duration_seconds,
 (attributes->>'host.sample_count')::bigint AS samples, attributes->>'build.id' AS build_id, trace_id
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND kind = 'span' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Comparable successful builds
display.description: Match scheme, configuration, destination, actions, project-clean cache state, scenario, Xcode version, and Mac model. Small counts are exploratory.

spec.query:
SELECT attributes->>'build.scheme' AS scheme, attributes->>'build.configuration' AS configuration,
 attributes->>'build.destination' AS destination, attributes->>'build.actions' AS actions,
 attributes->>'build.cache_state' AS cache, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario,
 attributes->>'xcode.version' AS xcode, attributes->>'host.model' AS mac_model,
 count(*) AS builds, avg((attributes->>'build.duration_seconds')::double) AS mean_seconds,
 min((attributes->>'build.duration_seconds')::double) AS min_seconds,
 max((attributes->>'build.duration_seconds')::double) AS max_seconds
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND kind = 'span' AND (attributes->>'build.exit_code')::bigint = 0
GROUP BY scheme, configuration, destination, actions, cache, scenario, xcode, mac_model
ORDER BY mean_seconds DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Aggregate compiler work
display.description: Tasks can overlap. These work totals are not a phase timeline or critical path.

spec.query:
SELECT start_timestamp AS started, attributes->>'build.scenario' AS scenario,
 (attributes->'xcode.task_seconds'->>'SwiftCompile')::double AS swift_seconds,
 coalesce((attributes->'xcode.task_seconds'->>'CompileMetalFile')::double, (attributes->'xcode.task_seconds'->>'Metal')::double) AS metal_seconds,
 (attributes->'xcode.task_seconds'->>'Ld')::double AS linker_seconds, trace_id
FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.build' AND kind = 'span' ORDER BY start_timestamp DESC LIMIT 100

display.name: Host CPU during builds
display.description: Whole-machine usage. Each series identifies a build; concurrent work can contribute.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'build.id' AS build_id, avg((attributes->>'cpu_utilization')::double) * 100 AS cpu_percent FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.host.sample' GROUP BY time, build_id ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Host memory during builds
display.description: Used memory based on operating-system available memory.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'build.id' AS build_id, avg((attributes->>'memory_utilization')::double) * 100 AS memory_percent FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.host.sample' GROUP BY time, build_id ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Available filesystem space
display.description: Space on the filesystem containing the working directory.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'build.id' AS build_id, avg((attributes->>'disk_free_bytes')::double) * 1.0 / 1073741824 AS free_gib FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.host.sample' GROUP BY time, build_id ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000

display.name: Host swap usage
display.description: Swap in use across the entire host. This is not a build-specific allocation.

spec.query: SELECT time_bucket($resolution, start_timestamp) AS time, attributes->>'build.id' AS build_id, avg((attributes->>'swap_used_bytes')::double) * 1.0 / 1048576 AS swap_mib FROM records WHERE service_name = 'xcode-observe' AND span_name = 'xcode.host.sample' GROUP BY time, build_id ORDER BY time LIMIT 10000
